topic: Conduit Minimum Inside Diameter Calculation
prompt: During pre-installation conduit verification, you must pull one RG59 coaxial SDI cable (6 mm outer diameter) and four Cat 6A UTP cables (8 mm outer diameter each) through a single conduit at a 40% (0.40) maximum fill factor.
